paragraphs.text: The Peregrine Dynamo is a construct originating from the plane of Dominaria .

The mechanical soldiers created by Urza had remained inactive for thousands of years, lying dormant and forgotten. Despite their long period of inactivity, the Thran technology that powered these constructs proved to be remarkably resilient. It sometimes took nothing more than a simple accident—such as a mountain goat stumbling upon one—to awaken these ancient war machines from their slumber. It was during one such event that Jhoira encountered the Peregrine Dynamo wandering through the countryside, loudly proclaiming, "DO NOT BE ALARMED!" to the nearby wildlife. Using her skills as an artificer , Jhoira was able to repair and reprogram the construct, ultimately gaining a loyal and reliable companion.
